q1: SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM (SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) AS T
q2: SELECT (SELECT NUM AS NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) =1 ORDER BY COUNT(NUM) DESC, NUM DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS NUM
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM (SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) AS T
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT (SELECT NUM AS NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) =1 ORDER BY COUNT(NUM) DESC, NUM DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS NUM
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects the maximum unique number, while Q2 selects the unique number with the highest count (which is always 1 for unique numbers, but Q2 orders by count and number in descending order to ensure the highest number is chosen among duplicates, which is not relevant here as all are unique).
